subject: Agriculture
title: Seeds Plus Fertilizer
description: A fast breakdown of Seeds Plus Fertilizer for builders.

hook.text: Green Revolution seeds were useless without fertilizer. The miracle was a package, not a single product.

buildup.text: Dwarf varieties were bred to respond to heavy nitrogen fertilizer. Without it, they yielded no better than old types.

discovery.text: Countries had to build fertilizer factories alongside seed distribution. India built dozens in the 1960s.

twist.text: Fertilizer costs money. Subsistence farmers who couldn't afford it were left out of the revolution.

climax.text: Government subsidies made fertilizer affordable—but created dependence on continued funding.

punchline.text: The seeds needed chemistry. The revolution was as much industrial as biological.

quiz.question: Why did Green Revolution seeds require fertilizer to achieve high yields?
options: They were bred to convert heavy nitrogen inputs into grain
